text:
chen: Heads-up — while canarying orion-v3-q4 (q4_0 dynamic) on multilingual, I hit a weird RTL/LTR punctuation attachment bug when inputs mix Simplified Chinese + Hebrew. BLEU dropped ~6 points vs fp16 baseline on our zh-he testset. repro + samples below.

chen: Repro (quick):
```python
inp = '今天天气很好. שלום, מה שלומך?'
# baseline (fp16) -> keeps punctuation next to Hebrew segment as expected
# orion-v3-q4 -> punctuation appears glued to the wrong side (moves to the LTR cluster)
```

chen: Example outputs: 
- expected: "今天天气很好. שלום, מה שלומך?"
- orion-v3-q4: "今天天气很好 .שלום, מה שלומך?"  <-- note space/punct shift before Hebrew chunk

chen: Metrics snapshot:
- baseline fp16 BLEU: 28.4
- orion-v3-q4 BLEU: 22.1
- automated token-level drift suggests token boundary shifts around the period and space near bidi transition.

alice: yikes. do we have the exact tokenization diff? can you paste tokenizer demo? :eyes:

chen: tokenization (huggingface tokenizer.encode demo):
```text
# baseline tokenizer.encode(inp) -> [345, 10234, 87, 11, 5001, 23, 999]  # (simplified sketch)
# q4 runtime token stream observed: [345, 10234, 87, 11, 5001, 999]  # missing explicit space token -> causes attach
```

dave: could be either tokenization normalization or something in the fastpath for q4 kernels that merges a trailing ascii punctuation with preceding han token when bidi flip occurs. did we run with the same tokenizer binary on the canary host?

chen: I double-checked — tokenizer wheel is identical (v2.3.1) on canary, but runtime pipeline differs: we run fast-kvcache+quant fused tokenizer on the q4 worker (custom preproc C++). suspect defect in bidi-aware whitespace handling in the C++ preproc.

ml-ci-bot: regression-detect: orion-v3-q4 on zh-he-testset -> BLEU delta: -6.3 (p<0.01). CI artifacts: gs://redwood-ci/artifacts/5312345678/

alice: OK can we get a minimal failing unit test? plz dump the exact bytes and tokenizer offsets for that input. I'll take the test and run a local compare. :thumbsup:

chen: uploading offsets/bytes to the CI bucket now (link in ml-ci-bot above). quick dump:
```text
raw_bytes: e4 b8 8a ...  (utf-8 bytes)
token_offsets_baseline: [[0,3],[3,6],[6,7],[7,10]]
 token_offsets_q4: [[0,3],[3,6],[6,7]]  # trailing space merged
```

dave: I'll instrument the q4 preproc to log bidi transitions and whitespace tokenization edgecases. tagging @alice in case we need a hotfix release after canary rollback.

alice: if it's a preproc bug we should rollback canary to fp16 quickly to avoid customer impact. also add a small eval to our onboarding smoke to include mixed-script bidi samples.

chen: Agreed — will run an AB with a quick patch (preserve explicit ascii-space token when transition detected) and post results here in ~2h. thanks y'all. :coffee:

alice: Thanks — ping when you have the AB numbers. (cc @dave for infra traces)
